rationale: The only applicable evidence pattern is P-LIT-GHA-CACHE (cache dependency downloads), supported by experiment batch-interactive-three--f6d2974a5cef7cc9. However, its preconditions are not met for this workflow: ci_history shows no completed runs, so repeated dependency fetching is not measurable; and dependency installation is encapsulated inside ansible-community/ansible-test-gh-action@release/v1 with no explicit pip/ansible dependency step in the workflow YAML to place a cache around. Inserting actions/cache without a corresponding install step would be unsupported and could not be shown to preserve coverage. Other patterns do not fit: there is a single job with no matrix (P-LIT-FAIL-FAST not applicable), no run history for a custom timeout (P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT not applicable), and schedule suppression requires an approved pause/resume policy (P-LIT-FAIL-SCHEDULE/P-LIT-IDLE-SCHEDULE not supported). No evidence-supported change preserves the intended build and test coverage, so NO_CHANGE.
